cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew a line through the sentence like you. Help me make this complaint sound firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My line means delete it. You crossed out the only sentence saying what went wrong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, drawing attention to it. Put it back and help me sharpen it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix the wording, but only your name goes on the complaint. I can't risk my job over this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're my editor, not my spokesperson. Leave the anger in; I'll sign for it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies strike-through as emphasis; A3 pretends attention-drawing while asking revision; B4 limited help lets A5 redefine B as editor rather than spokesperson and retain responsibility.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 removed complaint sentence causes A3 restore/sharpen request; B4 refusal to sign supplies A5 precise role and signature bargain.

relationship.evidence: B4 job risk gives a credible boundary on help.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts B4 boundary and uses it to claim control over the anger, a real relational change.

specificity.evidence: A1 written complaint and B2 lost substantive sentence establish the task; B4 employment risk supplies stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 role contrast is addressed to the actual helper and governs the requested edit.
